source.name: Football Italia, 'Official: Milan confirm €100m front-of-shirt sponsorship agreement'
source.quote: Reports in Italy suggest that this new extension will be worth around €100m to Milan over a five-year period, or in other words, €20m per season.

note: Five-year renewal of a partnership running since 2007 (front-of-shirt since 2010-11). SportsPro reported the deal as '€30m-a-year' citing La Gazzetta dello Sport — the two outlets disagree; both figures are press reports, not club filings.
